!Command: show running-config (the ePBR lines, recorded on cisco-25gb)
version 9.3(16) Bios:version 07.71 
feature epbr

interface Vlan251
  no shutdown
  ip address 198.51.101.1/24
  epbr ip policy web-chain 
  epbr ip policy web-chain reverse
  epbr ipv6 policy web6-chain 

epbr service firewall
  service-interface Vlan250
   probe icmp retry-down-count 5 
  service-end-point ip 198.51.100.10 interface Vlan250
     probe track 250
    reverse ip 198.51.100.20 interface Vlan250
       probe track 250
  service-end-point ip 198.51.100.13 interface Vlan250
     probe icmp 
    reverse ip 198.51.100.23 interface Vlan250

epbr service cache
  service-interface Vlan250
   probe icmp 
  service-end-point ip 198.51.100.30
     probe icmp 

epbr service firewall6
   probe icmp 
  service-end-point ipv6 2001:db8:250::10 interface Vlan250
    reverse ipv6 2001:db8:250::20 interface Vlan250

epbr policy web-chain
  statistics
  match ip address web
    load-balance method dst-ip 
    10 set service firewall fail-action drop
    30 set service firewall fail-action forward

epbr policy mail-chain
  match ip address mail
    load-balance method src-ip 
    10 set service cache

epbr policy web6-chain
  match ipv6 address web6
    10 set service firewall6
